T: One jump ahead. One plate behind.
D: A street thief in Agrabah finds a magic lamp and a genie, and tries to win the heart of Princess Jasmine.
P: Serve the snacks when Aladdin runs through the Agrabah market with the bread.
S: Aladdin running through the market with stolen bread
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus and labneh.
Abu the monkey grabbing whatever he can
Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed pistachios.
Soaked chickpeas blitzed with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped and fried at 180C until golden, with tahini sauce.
M: the big parade into the city
Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, cumin, cinnamon and paprika, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled over saffron rice with almonds and sultanas.
Chicken thighs slow cooked with onion, dried apricots, ginger, saffron and honey until sticky, served with couscous.
W: Filo layered with butter, pistachios, walnuts and cardamom, cut into diamonds, baked at 180C for 40 minutes and soaked in honey syrup.
K: Green tea brewed with plenty of mint and sugar, served hot in small glasses or iced.

s.note: Aladdin running through the market with stolen bread
s.how: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered. Tear into pieces and serve with a bowl of hummus and a bowl of labneh drizzled with more oil. Market stall style.

s.note: Abu the monkey grabbing whatever he can
s.how: Slit 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a teaspoon of almond butter and press closed. Dip halfway in melted dark chocolate and roll the end in crushed pistachios. Set in the fridge. Keep them away from any monkey.

m.note: the big parade into the city
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with garlic, cumin, cinnamon and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Cook 400g basmati with a pinch of saffron. Pile the lamb over the rice and scatter with toasted almonds.

w.how: Layer buttered filo sheets in a tin with chopped pistachios and walnuts mixed with cardamom between every few layers. Cut into diamonds and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Pour over warm honey syrup and leave to soak for hours.

d.how: Put 2 tbsp green tea leaves and a big bunch of fresh mint into a teapot with sugar to taste. Pour over a litre of just-boiled water and steep 4 minutes. Pour from a height into small glasses, or chill and serve over ice.
